Placemaker.Recipe.AnimalPark.Description: A visitor attraction of fenced enclosures: petting farm, paddocks, horse paddock with arena, deer park or aviary garden, with a walk, hub and viewpoints.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.Name: Animal park
Placemaker.AnimalPark.Issue.NoPens: No room for enclosures: try fewer pens, another walk layout or a larger area.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.kind.Tooltip: Sets the pen ground, shelters and which animals the spawners call for.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.pens.Tooltip: How many fenced pens the space between the walks is cut into.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.shelters.Tooltip: A shelter, stable or hutch at the back of each pen, away from the walk.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.walkIn.Tooltip: Petting and bird pens get an open gate on the walk side so visitors can go in.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.arena.Tooltip: A fenced sand arena with a course of jumps, cut out before the pens.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.aviaries.Tooltip: Bird cages beside the walks, outside the pens.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.animals.Tooltip: Animal spawners in the pens (only where the game has suitable spawners).
Placemaker.AnimalPark.pond.Tooltip: A pond inside the largest enclosure. Permanent terrain change.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.layout.Tooltip: Loop: a walk round the inside of the edge with pens in the middle. Spine: a central walk with pens either side. Trail: winding paths with pens between them.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.hub.Tooltip: A yard by the entrance with a barn, kiosk and picnic tables; features such as the playground go in its middle.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.viewpoints.Tooltip: Bench pairs on the walk facing the largest pens (a lookout in a deer park).
Placemaker.AnimalPark.benchSpacing.Toolt: Benches beside the walks every so many metres; 0 = none.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.shadeTrees.Tooltip: Trees per hectare, inside the pens and round the walks.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.woodland.Tooltip: Wooded pasture inside the pens: share of the ground under trees.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.hedgerow.Tooltip: A hedge just inside the outline, with gaps at the entrances.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.wornGround.Tooltip: Paints trampled earth inside each pen gate. Permanent.
Placemaker.AnimalPark.groundLayer.Toolti: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint (depends on the map).
Placemaker.AnimalPark.terrain.Tooltip: Gentle mounds (goat hills, deer park) or a level site; blended back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
